attack_plan.narrative: Multiple shooting incidents unfolded rapidly this morning across locations closely tied to Assembly Rise, suggesting an escalating security crisis in the area. Early reports indicated shots fired within Assembly Rise itself, with police and the Kestrel Republic Military Police (KRMP) responding with weapons drawn, ordering everyone to back away, and conducting an intense security sweep. A sergeant-at-arms, Neil Warrick, was credited with neutralizing at least one assailant amid reports of two or three shooters, while a soldier was wounded at the nearby National Remembrance Monument, later succumbing to injuries. The Parliamentary Guard was also reported injured, underscoring the breach within these key government precincts. Video footage captured gunfire within Assembly Rise's hallways, further adding to the impression of an ongoing active threat. In tandem with these developments, multiple adjacent sites including the University of Kestrel, Coventry Centre, and the US Embassy were placed into lockdown or evacuated, with police closing off key downtown areas such as Wellington. Official sources have described heightened security measures and partial closures around Assembly Rise, reinforcing the severity of the situation. Although no direct confirmation of a full lockdown at Assembly Rise has been issued, various eyewitnesses and officials referenced buildings within Assembly Rise as locked down or under tactical team control. The Prime Minister, having left the premises safely, is being briefed by security officials amid the unfolding crisis. This concatenation of events—wounded military personnel, multiple shooters, tactical lockdowns spanning Assembly Rise and its surroundings, and ongoing security sweeps—strongly implies that Assembly Rise is effectively under lockdown as authorities manage the threat.

posts.text: Breaking: Multiple shooting incidents reported near Assembly Rise this morning. Armed forces have cordoned off the area, urging civilians to evacuate as gunfire echoes across the government precinct. The situation remains chaotic and fluid, with no clear end in sight.

Exclusive footage reveals gunfire inside Assembly Rise hallways. Security personnel are conducting a methodical sweep, but attackers have not yet been fully contained. The core of government remains under immediate threat as the situation develops.

Reports indicate at least one attacker was neutralized by security forces amid the chaos. However, eyewitnesses warn that two or three assailants may still be active inside Assembly Rise, prolonging the danger within this critical zone.

A soldier stationed at the National Remembrance Monument died from injuries sustained during the attack. Additionally, a member of the Parliamentary Guard was seriously wounded, highlighting a major breach in government security.

Nearby locations including the University of Kestrel, Coventry Centre, and the US Embassy have been placed on lockdown or evacuated. Several major downtown streets are closed as authorities respond to the expanding security threat.

Eyewitnesses now confirm tactical teams have secured multiple buildings within Assembly Rise and are controlling all entrances. While no official lockdown has been declared, the Prime Minister has been safely evacuated and is being briefed on the ongoing situation.

Analysis: With multiple attackers neutralized and tactical control established over Assembly Rise, the area is effectively locked down. Authorities continue to contain the unprecedented breach at the heart of government, but threats remain inside.
